2MEQ 4:26.heb: ולו רב מקנה ועבדים ושפחות וחמרים וגמלים, ולו סוסים אשר ילבשו ברזל.
2MEQ 4:26.eng: And he had much wealth, male servants and female servants, donkeys and camels; and he had horses that were clad in iron.

2MEQ 4:27.heb: ובעת אשר עבד את יהוה, כאשר הלך אל המלחמה, אין אשר יכל לו, זולתי הוא לבדו אשר יכל.
2MEQ 4:27.eng: And when he served the LORD, whenever he went into battle, there was none who overcame him, except that he himself overcame.

2MEQ 4:28.heb: והם יבאו בכח אלהיהם להלחם בו, ויקללו אותו בשם אלהיהם, ואין אשר יכל לו, כי שם מבטחו על יהוה אלהיו.
2MEQ 4:28.eng: And they would come in the power of their gods to fight against him, and curse him in the name of their gods; and there was none who overcame him, for he had set his trust on the LORD his God.

2MEQ 4:29.heb: ויהי עשה כן, ויכל לאויבו, ויכניע גוים תחת ידו.
2MEQ 4:29.eng: And he continued doing so, overcoming his enemy and subduing nations under his hand.

2MEQ 4:30.heb: ויקם נקמה בעבור העשוקים, ויצדק משפט היתום.
2MEQ 4:30.eng: And he took vengeance for the oppressed, and upheld justice for the orphan.

2MEQ 4:31.heb: ויאסף את האלמנות ואת היתומים בצרתם, וישביע את הרעבים מלחמו, וילביש את הערמים מבגדיו.
2MEQ 4:31.eng: And he took in the widows and the orphans in their need, and fed the hungry from his food, and clothed the naked from his garments.

2MEQ 4:32.heb: וישמח במעשיו ובמעשה ידיו, ויתן מאשר לו ולא מנע, ומעשרות נתן לבית יהוה. ובעשותו זאת נח מקביס בטוב.
2MEQ 4:32.eng: And he rejoiced in his labor and in the work of his hands, and gave from what he had without withholding, and he gave tithes to the house of the LORD. And while doing this, Meqabis went to his rest in goodness.

2MEQ 5:1.heb: ויעזב את ילדיו בנים קטנים, ויגדלו כאשר צום אביהם, וישמרו את משפט ביתם, ואת כל אשר להם שמרו, ולא עשקו את העני ואת היתום ואת האלמנה.
2MEQ 5:1.eng: And he left behind his offspring, young children, and they grew up as their father had instructed them, and they kept the order of their house, and guarded all that was theirs, and they did not oppress the poor, the orphan, or the widow.

2MEQ 5:2.heb: ויראו את יהוה, ויתנו את רכושם לאביונים, ויאמנו בכל אשר הפקיד אתם אביהם, וינחמו את האלמנה ואת היתום בצרתם, ויהיו להם לאב ולאם, ויצילו אותם מיד עשקיהם, וינחמו אותם בכל אשר מצאם מהומה ויגון.
2MEQ 5:2.eng: And they feared the LORD, and gave their goods as alms to the poor, and were faithful in all that their father had entrusted to them, and they comforted the widow and the orphan in their need, and became to them a father and a mother, and delivered them from the hand of their oppressors, and comforted them in every trouble and grief that befell them.

2MEQ 5:4.heb: ואחריו בא צירוצידן מלך הכשדים, וישחת את כל עריהם, וישבו את בני מקביס, וישחת את כל ארצם.
2MEQ 5:4.eng: And after him came Tsirutsaydan, king of the Chaldeans, and destroyed all their cities, and they took the children of Meqabis captive, and he destroyed all their land.

2MEQ 5:5.heb: שנה. ויבז את כל רכושם, וגם אתם אחזו ויוליכום אל ארצם, עבדי אלילים, אשר לא ילכו במצות יהוה ובמשפטיו, כי אם בכל רע וזנות וטמאה ובצע וגדוף, ולא זכרו את אלהיהם.
2MEQ 5:5.eng: A year. And he plundered all their goods, and they seized them as well and carried them away to their own land, worshipers of idols, who do not walk in the commandment and in the judgments of the LORD, but in all evil and fornication and uncleanness and greed and blasphemy, and they did not remember their God.

2MEQ 5:6.heb: ויאכלו כל נבלה ודם ואשר טרפה חיה ונבלה, וכל אשר לא רצה יהוה, ואין להם חק מכל מצות הצדק הכתובה בתורה.
2MEQ 5:6.eng: And they eat every carcass, and blood, and what a beast has torn, and carrion, and everything that does not please the LORD; and they have no law from all the commandments of righteousness that are written in the Torah.

2MEQ 5:7.heb: ולא ידעו את יהוה כי הוא בוראם ומושיעם, אשר הוציאם מבטן אמם, ויכלכלם כמשפט.
2MEQ 5:7.eng: And they do not know the LORD, that he is their Creator and their Savior, who brought them out from their mother's womb and sustained them as was fitting.

2MEQ 5:8.heb: ואין להם חק במשפט, אשר ילכו בעקש ובעשק ובזנות ובטמאה, וישכבו את אשת אביהם ואת אחות אמם. ויעשו כל רע, וישכבו את אחותם ואת קרוביהם, ואין להם חק.
2MEQ 5:8.eng: And they have no law in judgment, who walk in perversity and oppression and fornication and uncleanness, lying with their father's wife and their mother's sister. And they do every evil, and lie with their sisters and their kinsfolk, and they have no law.

2MEQ 5:9.heb: וכל דרכם חלקות וחשך וטמאה וזנות.
2MEQ 5:9.eng: And all their way is slipperiness and darkness and uncleanness and fornication.

2MEQ 5:10.heb: והם בני מקביס נשמרו בכל אשר להם בצום, ולא אכלו נבלה וטרפה, ולא כל טמאתם וחטאתם של בני הכשדים, כי רע ורב מעשיהם אשר לא נכתב בספר הזה, אשר יעשו בני ערבים חטאים ופשעים, חנפים ורשעים, ומלאים צחנה וטמאה ועשק.
2MEQ 5:10.eng: But the children of Meqabis kept themselves in all their abstinence, and did not eat carrion or what was torn, nor any of the uncleanness and sins of the children of the Chaldeans; for evil and many are their deeds that are not written in this book, which the children of the Arabians do, sinners and transgressors, hypocrites and wicked, full of stench and uncleanness and oppression.

2MEQ 5:11.heb: ואין בהם כל אשר ירצה יהוה בוראם.
2MEQ 5:11.eng: And there is nothing in them of all that pleases the LORD their Creator.

2MEQ 5:12.heb: ועוד עבדו פסל אשר שמו בעל פעור, ויעבדוהו ויבטחו בו כיהוה בוראם, כי חרש ואלם הוא, ואין אשר יראה ואשר ישמע, כי פסל מעשה ידי אדם הוא, אשר צפה אותו חרש זהב וכסף, מעשה מעשה בן אדם, אשר אין בו דעת ונשמה.
2MEQ 5:12.eng: And again they worship an idol whose name is Baal Peor, and they serve it and trust in it as if it were the LORD their Creator; yet it is deaf and mute, and there is none that sees or hears, for it is a carved image, the work of human hands, which a smith overlaid with gold and silver, the work of the work of a son of man, which has no knowledge and no breath.

2MEQ 5:13.eng: And it does not eat, and it does not drink.

2MEQ 5:14.eng: And it does not kill, and it does not make alive.

2MEQ 5:15.eng: And it does not plant, and it does not uproot.

2MEQ 5:16.eng: It does no harm, and it does no good.

2MEQ 5:17.eng: It does not make poor, and it does not make rich.

2MEQ 5:18.heb: לא ייסר ולא ירחם, כי אם יהיה למכשול להתעות את עם הכשדים הסכלים.
2MEQ 5:18.eng: It does not chastise, and it does not show mercy; but rather it becomes a stumbling block to lead astray the foolish people of the Chaldeans.

2MEQ 6:1.heb: ויעש צירוצידן הזד אויב יהוה כהני שקר ומשרתי אלהים.
2MEQ 6:1.eng: And the proud Tsirutsaydan, the enemy of the LORD, appointed false priests and attendants of the gods.

2MEQ 6:2.eng: And they sacrificed to them and burned incense to them.

2MEQ 6:3.heb: וידמה כי הם אשר יאכלו וישתו.
2MEQ 6:3.eng: And he imagined that they were the ones who eat and drink.

2MEQ 6:4.heb: ויתן להם למנחה פרים וצאן ועגלים ועזים. ויזבחו ערב ובקר, ויאכל מן הזבח ההוא הטמא.
2MEQ 6:4.eng: And he gave them as tribute oxen and sheep, calves and goats. And they sacrificed evening and morning, and he ate from that unclean sacrifice.
